about: tooling/gate.sh's baselines on hardac1 (card 0 the Arc Pro B70, card 1 the B65): each engine's quick run - the prompt's logits and greedy tokens hashed (exact), pp and tg in tok/s (best of two) - and the shared parts' engines. Recorded with NS_GATE_RECORD=1 on the commit named; a change that moves a number on purpose records it again in its pull request.
